exposure: visual analog scale (VAS) score of preoperative dysmenorrhea
postoperative junctional zone measured by magnetic resonance imaging (JZmax-A)
cohort: 137 patients with diffuse adenomyosis who underwent double-flap adenomyomectomy.
finding: Double-flap adenomyomectomy improved fertility in patients with diffuse adenomyosis, with postoperative JZmax-A being a promising indicator for predicting pregnancy outcomes.
